About Me

This is my personal blog built with Jekyll.

Step 1: Installation

Jekyll requires Ruby, Gem, and Bundler. Follow the official installation guide.

Step 2: Create a New Post

Posts are stored in the _posts directory. Create a new file with the format YYYY-MM-DD-title.md.

Step 3: Add Images

Images go in the assets/images/ folder. Reference them using relative paths.

Step 4: Publish

Commit your changes and push to GitHub. GitHub Pages will automatically build your site.
